title: Pentaryn Drop Bin
description: An append-only ledger of every item that leaves a character. Records Item Piles drops to the ground and outright deletions from a sheet, in the order they happened, with the item's complete source data — so a two-hander dropped in a corridor three sessions ago can be handed back exactly as it was. Writes to a world setting and mirrors to assets/drop-bin/drop-log.json. GM is the only writer; player clients route their entries through socketlib. Exposes game.pentaryn.dropbin. Also turns dead NPCs into lootable piles (Dead as the full-body overlay, a drawn eye while there is loot) and adds a Loot all button to Item Piles loot windows.

recommends.reason: Drop capture, corpse piles, the Loot all button and container locks are built on Item Piles.
The rarity i18n shim targets the Item Piles dnd5e system module's labels.

afterSync: Already enabled? A browser RELOAD (F5) picks up .mjs changes; module.json needs a restart.
Item Piles loot windows get a 'Loot all' button; corpses show Dead as the overlay plus a drawn eye.
